qualityofqueso.options.better_gui_exit.t:
Close any GUI menu when you click anywhere outside of the GUI screen.

For example, clicking off of the crafting inventory screen (as long as your cursor isn't holding anything) will close the screen.
Begin typing no matter what screen you are on to search for items.

For example, if you are in the creative inventory menu screen, and you want to search for an item, you no longer have to click on the compass to search for an item. Just begin typing and it will begin searching. The same applies to recipe book screens and crafting screens. (Note: if your cursor is hovered over a slot with an item that is bound to a hotbar key, it will not automatically search. You must move your mouse away from the bounded hotbar slot.)
qualityofqueso.options.chest_searching.t: Search items in containers like chests and shulker boxes.
Searches the players inventory in addition to searching for items in a container.
Saves the text in search bars when exiting the container.
qualityofqueso.options.transferring.tool:
Transfer items to another container/inventory.

Shortcut keys:
CTRL + %s (inventory -> container)
CTRL + %s (container -> inventory)
qualityofqueso.options.transferring.shor: Use shortcut key or button to transfer items.
Only use shortcut key to transfer items.
qualityofqueso.options.container_sorting:
Alphabetically sort all items in a container.

Shortcut key = CTRL + %s
Use shortcut key or button to sort a container.
Only use shortcut key to sort a container.
qualityofqueso.options.quick_drop.toolti:
Quick drop (or throw) all items in a container/inventory.
Hold shift to only throw out one of each item.

Shortcut key = §oCTRL + ALT + Q + (SHIFT, only if you want to throw 1 of each item)
qualityofqueso.options.quick_drop.shortc: Use shortcut key or button to quick drop.
Only use shortcut key to quick drop.
qualityofqueso.options.swapping.tooltip:
Swap all items in a container with the corresponding inventory slot.

Shortcut key = CTRL + %s
qualityofqueso.options.swapping.shortcut: Use shortcut key or button to swap items.
Only use shortcut key to swap items.
qualityofqueso.options.include_hotbar.to: Include hotbar slots when transferring or searching.
qualityofqueso.options.perpendicular_qui:
When "quick moving" (shift+clicking) items in a container, items are moved straight down, perpendicular to their opposing slot.

Disable this option if you want to use Minecraft's default system, where items move parallel. Please note, when moving items and excluding hotbar, perpendicular quick moving will be used regardless.
qualityofqueso.options.move_items_if.too: Determines when transferring items is applicable.
qualityofqueso.options.move_items_if.con: Allow transferring of items §oonly if§r§f every slot in the container isn't filled (regardless of item count).
qualityofqueso.options.move_items_if.les: If container/inventory is full, allow transferring of items if the §lto-slot's item count §r§f§o(the slot that the item is being moved to)§r§f §l§oPLUS§r§f the §lfrom-slot's item count §r§f§o(the slot being moved)§r§f is §oLESS§r§f than the §lto-slot's §lmax item count.
qualityofqueso.options.move_items_if.can: If container/inventory is full, allow transferring of items if the §lto-slot's item count §r§f§o(the slot that the item is being moved to)§r§f is §oless§r§f than its §lmax item count.
qualityofqueso.options.drag_to_sort.tool:
Hold ALT and drag click to manually exclude slots from searching and transferring.
Hold ALT + SHIFT and drag click to manually pick slots to search/transfer.

Note: if moving to an excluded slot, the item will still move to that slot. This feature only applies to searching and picking transfers.
qualityofqueso.options.save_excluded_slo: Saves all excluded slots when closing a container, and re-applies them when opening a container of the same size.
qualityofqueso.options.show_button_outli: Shows inventory management button outlines when holding down the §oCTRL§r§f key.
qualityofqueso.options.show_button_short: Shows inventory management button shortcut keys when holding down the §oCTRL§r§f key (only shows if keybind is bounded to the default key).
qualityofqueso.options.enable_mod.toolti: Enables all Quality of Queso features.
qualityofqueso.options.armor_status.tool: Display your armor items near your hotbar.
qualityofqueso.options.armor_status.on_c: Display armor status when item or durability is changed.
qualityofqueso.options.item_count.toolti: Displays the total amount of the item you are holding near your hotbar.
qualityofqueso.options.item_count.stacks:
Displays how many stacks of the held item you have.

For example:
4x 64. - Means you have exactly 4 stacks.
Otherwise, displays the exact amount.
qualityofqueso.options.item_count.remain:
Displays how many stacks of the held item you have, plus any remaining that don't add up to a stack.

For example:
8x64 & 7 - Means you have 8 stacks, plus 7 additional.
Displays the item count of a thrown item (for 4 seconds).
qualityofqueso.options.display_on_pickup: Displays the item count of a picked up item (for 4 seconds).
Searches transportable containers in your inventory (like shulker boxes and bundles) for your held item, and adds it to the total item count.
qualityofqueso.options.display_total_wit: Displays the exact amount in addition to the amount of stacks (if "Item Count" is set to STACKS or REMAINDER).
qualityofqueso.options.quick_equip.toolt:
Quickly equip the hovered item to it's respective equipment slot by right-clicking, or using the shortcut key.

Shortcut key = %s
qualityofqueso.options.prevent_rage_quit:
Prevents the player from quickly pressing the "disconnect" button after opening up the pause menu.

Manny struggles with this...
qualityofqueso.options.prevent_e_from_ty: Prevents the "E" key from beginning to type in any search field (if unfocused).
Displays helpful tooltips for this mod.
qualityofqueso.options.blacklisted_serve:
Add your blacklisted servers here.

All features will be disabled on any blacklisted server.

Separate each blacklisted server with a comma (§l,)§r§f.

You can also add/remove blacklisted servers if you join the server and toggle it via the pause menu (if you have "QoQ Buttons" set to "Everywhere").
qualityofqueso.options.item_frame_search:
Search for an item frame with a specific item inside of it and make it glow.

Shortcut key = %s

Determines the radius for finding item frames.

1m = 1 block.

Specifies how long item frames will remain glowing.

§cIndefinite §r§fmeans item frames will remain glowing forever, or until cleared by the player.
qualityofqueso.options.show_in_game_time: Displays Minecraft's in-game time in the debug screen.
qualityofqueso.options.show_irl_time.too: Displays your current real-life time in the debug screen.
qualityofqueso.options.multi_server_conf:
Create a Quality of Queso (QoQ) configuration preset for each server that you join. This means that each server you play on will have it's own QoQ configuration. When you disconnect from the server, your "global" config will be re-applied.

You can find your server config files in ".minecraft/config/qoq/server-configs".
qualityofqueso.options.fog.disabled: This feature will not work because "applyFogFunction" is disabled. Re-enable it by going into the universal QoQ config file.
qualityofqueso.options.fog.simple_keybin: Because you have the Simple Keybinds mod loaded, you need to use that keybind to toggle fog on/off. Changing this will do nothing.
qualityofqueso.options.auto_close_recipe: Automatically closes the recipe book when closing the screen.
qualityofqueso.options.mob_hit_ding.tool:
Plays the ding sound effect when hitting a mob with an arrow from at least %s blocks away, similar to when you hit a player.
If the arrow fails to do damage, you will instead hear a shield blocking sound.
If you kill the mob, you will hear a level-up sound effect.
qualityofqueso.options.min_mob_hit_ding_: Determines the minimum distance (in blocks) that the player must be from a mob in order to play the ding sound effect when hitting it with an arrow (default = 20).
qualityofqueso.options.qoq_buttons.every: Display all Quality of Queso configuration buttons on title §oand pause screen.
qualityofqueso.options.qoq_buttons.title: §b§lTITLE ONLY

Only display the Quality of Queso settings button on title screen.
This will not display the blacklisted server button on the pause screen.
qualityofqueso.options.qoq_buttons.off.t:
Do not display any Quality of Queso configuration buttons.

Note: The only way to change this option back is to change this option in the config file directly.
